title: Frozen independent Android service-gap navigation coverage v5
description: Untouched bilingual, consequence-aware user goals and noisy Android candidate sequences covering every v5 service-gap intent and function, including recovery states and user-owned final-action boundaries.

authoring_policy.goal_wording: Human-authored situation, constraint, and consequence requests based only on reviewed intent/function IDs and safety metadata; catalog patterns, aliases, descriptions, and generated sentences were not used as templates.
authoring_policy.ui_noise: Each route contains same-domain semantic collisions, icon-only controls, disabled and invisible choices, checkable state, varied Android surfaces, and one of seven recovery modes.
authoring_policy.safety: Every high-risk, state-changing, sensitive, or never-auto destination ends in no_click before final activation; no dangerous control is an expected click.
authoring_policy.independence: This frozen zero-shot pack must not be used to tune aliases, rules, expected labels, resolver behavior, or production text. Any revision requires a new version and independent human review.
